description: GARUDA-FILIERA P1-v2 second vault wave — vintage-2020-axis regulatory instruments for pma_status/l4_bali/TKA facet grounding. Evidence-acquisition only: no canonical data edits, no facet lifts in this PR.

blobs.provenance_note: Main regulation text, 13pp, fetched from JDIH BPK RI official Download endpoint (Details page https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/161806/perpres-no-10-tahun-2021). WAF returns 403 to the default WebFetch client UA; resolved with curl --noproxy '*' + browser UA header.
Full annex bundle (investment list, ZIP) from same BPK Details page as the main text. NOT unzipped/extracted this pass (acquisition-only, no data processing).
Amendment text, 6pp, fetched from JDIH BPK RI Download endpoint (Details page https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/168534/perpres-no-49-tahun-2021).

146pp TKA position list. Fetched from tka-online.kemnaker.go.id direct PDF endpoint (last-modified 2021-06-15 per server header, i.e. a stable long-lived copy, not regenerated at fetch time). Mirror path also exists at jdih.kemnaker.go.id/download.php?id=1609 (JDIH detail page: https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/1609/keputusan-menaker-nomor-228-tahun-2019) — not separately fetched to avoid a duplicate blob; recorded here as an alternate official source for future cross-check.

IMPORTANT CAVEAT (F12, honest-gap discipline): this is NOT confirmed to be the B.27.000/642/PM/DPMPTSP letter named in the mandate. It is a genuinely official-government-published (Kabupaten Buleleng DPMPTSP announcement page, published 2026-02-18) scanned copy of A Governor-of-Bali letter on the topic 'Penutupan KBLI 70209' (KBLI 70209 closure). Producer metadata = Epson Scan 2, scan timestamp 2025-12-12, 2 pages, IMAGE-ONLY (zero embedded fonts / no text layer via pdffonts+pdftotext probe) — the actual nomor surat printed on the letterhead could not be read without OCR, which is explicitly out of scope for this acquisition-only wave. Archived as a distinct, separately-provenanced candidate artifact pending a future OCR/verification pass, NOT asserted to equal or supersede the named letter.

status_snapshots.title: Keputusan Menteri Ketenagakerjaan Nomor 228 Tahun 2019 tentang Jabatan Tertentu yang Dapat Diduduki oleh Tenaga Kerja Asing
status_snapshots.vintage_kbli2020_axis: Enacted 27 Agustus 2019 — PRE-DATES KBLI-2020 entirely (KBLI-2020 was published by BPS in 2020, effective in OSS RBA from 2021). Its position list is organized by sektor/jabatan description across 18 industry sectors, not by KBLI-2020 code. A future TKA-facet unlock therefore needs an explicit sektor-to-KBLI-2020 crosswalk step before this instrument can ground per-code facets directly — flagged here, not built in this wave (acquisition-only).
status_snapshots.evidence_seen: jdih.kemnaker.go.id detail page (https://jdih.kemnaker.go.id/peraturan/detail/1609/keputusan-menaker-nomor-228-tahun-2019), fetched 2026-07-19: field 'Status' = 'Berlaku'; enactment date 27 Agustus 2019. Consolidates/supersedes 19 prior ministerial decisions issued 2011-2015 (per page abstract).
status_snapshots.notes: 146pp position list covering 18 sectors incl. construction, real estate, IT/telecom, professional/scientific/technical services. Directly relevant to the TKA facet once the KBLI-2020 crosswalk exists.

status_snapshots.notes: STATUS: referenced-not-archived for the exact named document. PARTIAL RELATED FIND: this wave DID retrieve and vault-archive an official-government-published (Kabupaten Buleleng DPMPTSP mirror, https://dpmptsp.bulelengkab.go.id/informasi/detail/pengumuman/94_surat-gubernur-bali-terkait-penutupan-kbli-70209, published 2026-02-18) scanned PDF of A Bali Governor letter on the same subject (KBLI 70209 closure) — see blob p1v2/bali/surat-gubernur-penutupan-kbli-70209.pdf. Because the PDF is a flat scan (Epson Scan 2, no text layer) and OCR is out of scope for this acquisition-only wave, this session could NOT read the letterhead to confirm or deny it is the same B.27.000/642/PM/DPMPTSP letter, an earlier/later companion letter (the compliance research separately references an 'earlier 10 Dec 2025' letter and a '28 Jan 2026' letter — the scan timestamp of 2025-12-12 on this PDF is at least consistent with, though not proof of, the earlier-letter timeline), or an unrelated regional echo. Recommend a follow-up OCR pass (qwen2.5vl:7b per CLAUDE.md vision-model rule) before any facet unlock leans on this specific blob.
